content:
Sam: Heads-up — Nimbus Health signed term sheet. They want a 2-week trial to validate inference for clinical note summarization. Need scope: acceptance criteria (latency/cost/quality), security checklist (PHI/BAA), and pricing guidance. Who can own the POC runbook?

Alex: I can lead the POC tech runbook. Quick clarifying q: will they send PHI in production? If yes we should plan Private or Dedicated with KMS.

Maria: They flagged PHI during the NDA call. Will need BAA, SOC2 Type II evidence, KMS integration, and audit logs exported. Also ask client for data flow diagram.

Lee: Infra note — for 99th pct burst we can provision 4x A100s in us-east-1 for the trial. If we start with hosted, latency will be fine but data residency and BAA push toward Dedicated/Private. Need sample QPS and typical request size.

Olivia: To align expectations, propose acceptance KPIs: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 400ms on 512-token requests; cost target < $8 per 1k tokens for inference; hallucination/incorrect-summary rate < 5% measured by a 200-prompt human eval set. Thoughts?

Sam: Client also called out max latency for interactive workflows ~300ms p95 and they want cost estimates for both hosted and dedicated. They want the eval to finish within 2 weeks.

Alex: Runbook sketch (high level):
1) Day 0: collect sample prompts (200 clinical notes + expected summary length) + traffic profile (QPS, concurrency, token distribution).
2) Days 1-3: spin infra, baseline tests against open model + quantized variant.
3) Days 4-8: run evals (automated + 200 human checks).
4) Days 9-10: iterate prompt templates and batching/caching config.
5) Day 11-14: final report + handoff.

Alex: Example eval prompt we want from sales (paste into repo/tests):
```
Input: "Patient presented with chest pain, afebrile, troponin trending down. Summarize in 2-3 bullets focusing on disposition and next steps."
Expected: 2-3 bullets mentioning disposition and follow-up.
```

Alex: Metrics we will capture (send to Console/tracing): upstream_latency_ms, model_p50_ms, model_p95_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_estimate_per_1k, hallucination_flag (human tag).

Maria: Security asks: send standard security questionnaire + data flow. Confirm whether client requires customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) and VPC peering. Also confirm retention policy for logs and whether we redact PHI before persistent storage.

Lee: Autoscaling suggestion: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=8, target_cpu=60%; enable prefix/KV caching for repeated templates to reduce cost. Example autoscale config snippet: 
```
autoscale:
  min: 2
  max: 8
  metric: concurrency
  target: 50
```

Sam: Pricing question from client: hosted vs dedicated delta — they want a per-month estimate for sustained 200 RPS with bursts to 500 RPS. Can finance/solutions provide a ballpark?

Olivia: I'll coordinate a short pricing model ask — Alex/Lee, please capture expected GPU hours and memory footprint. Maria, if Dedicated/Private required we should include SOC2/BAA uplift in the price.

Alex: Quick curl example we'll use to validate latency from their network:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"rwd-large-qa","input":"<sample>"}' | jq .
```

Sam: Timeline check — client wants kickoff Monday. Can we commit to runbook + infra readiness by EOD Monday so they can send prompts?

Alex: I can have infra runbook + baseline tests ready by EOD Monday if we get sample prompts by noon Monday.

Maria: I'll prep the security questionnaire and checklist by Monday morning and flag any blockers.

Lee: I'll draft the infra plan and provisional cost estimate for the 200RPS sustained / 500RPS burst scenario.

Olivia: I'll set up daily 10:00am check-ins for the trial and a shared doc for results. Sam — please push the sample prompt set + traffic CSV into the shared folder.

Sam: Done — uploaded sample_prompts_v1.csv and traffic_profile.csv to the Nimbus folder. Added client contact (emailed them the kickoff calendar invite). :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: dedicated-trial-nimbus | env=staging | owner=Alex | eta=2026-04-07T18:00Z

Alex: Great — I'll kick the deploy after infra review. Assigning owners: Alex (POC lead), Maria (security owner), Lee (infra lead), Olivia (client PM).

Sam: Perfect. We'll reconvene Mon 10:00am. Thanks everyone.
